what: The big intro paragraph is split into words, all set to 14% opacity, and from when the paragraph top touches 80% of the screen until its bottom touches 45%, they sharpen one by one from the first word (stagger .1), tied to scroll — scroll back up and they blur again

options.scrub: If a number, follows that much later (seconds), default immediate
options.by: If chars, goes letter by letter in turn instead of word by word (word chunks are wrapped intact so line breaks never split inside a word), default words
options.look: In step mode it is not tied to scroll and only decides how many words light up — the ratio of the paragraph top moving from screen bottom (0) to top (1) × fill, rounded up, gives the number of leading words that turn on, and each word transitions over --fx-dur between from ↔ 1 (Fill Text effect). Default is scrub
options.fill: look: multiplier applied to the ratio in step, default 1 — haptic 1.2 (fully lit once the paragraph’s top edge reaches about 1/6 of the screen)
options.lead: look: step — up to this ratio none are lit at all (0~.9), default 0
options.range: look: for step with page, counting uses the overall document scroll progress p instead of paragraph position — lit up to ⌊p × (cells + tail + 1)⌋ − 1 cells (reference site). The default is paragraph position
options.tail: range: number of blank slots appended at the end of the page — the larger, the sooner everything lights up before the document end, default 0 (brand 12)
options.[data-fx-part=slot]: (child, optional) A picture or button between text lines — counted as one word slot without splitting, and when lit it receives is-fx-lit and the fx:lit event (detail.on·index). The picture’s lit motion is attached by the user through that event
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: look: step word transition length · curve (via style), default .6s · cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)

use: Put a long intro paragraph here …

from.where: index.html intro paragraph above the numbers .statement__text

index.html quote [data-quote] — original SplitType words .25→1, gap .1, from the section (.section_layout484) top at screen center → section end at center (phone top 35% → bottom 90%), scrub 2. In the original the trigger is the section, not the paragraph.
from.options: from: .25; stagger: .1; start: top center; end: bottom center; scrub: 2

from.where: index.html brand story [data-behind-text] — original SplitText letters .2→1, length .01 · gap .004 (pinned section scroll ratio), starting from the .75 point of the Hero pinned section
index.html About paragraph .hp-intro__text — original Framer Fill Text (mode word · fillSpeed 1.2 · startDelay 0 · off words .2 · opacity .6s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) · delay 0)

shared.js data-words-light (blue word lit-up section — three subpages) · services.html .s-row__ttl · about.html .a-globe__ttl — original TextSection: from .1 · stagger .16 (length .18) · start top center+=20% · end bottom-=25% center · scrub 1.2, wide screens only. Via this part’s options "from: .1; stagger: .16; start: top center+=20%; end: bottom-=25% center; scrub: 1.2"

service.html big paragraph and quote. Original KaraokeText: word color #a3a3a3 → text color, each word takes .4s staggered by .15s for a total of 1, start top 70% · end bottom center · scrub .6. Gray (#a3a3a3) on a dark background. = White text is .64 transparent, so "from: 0.64; start: top 70%; end: bottom center; scrub: 0.6"

index.html .rb-text — original framer-motion useScroll: ⌊p × 117⌋ − 1 from document progress > Turn on the cell at its sequence number, word .25→1 opacity .5s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1). Picture cells (team faces·reel·field-word Rive·score·calendar·hand) are also counted one by one, with 12 empty cells at the end.
from.options: look: step; range: page; from: .25; tail: 12

note: Spaces between words stay as they are and only the words are wrapped (SplitText words) — Korean line breaks never split in the middle of a word. With reduced motion it’s clear from the start
